# Genset start-up

Cold start, engine room hatch open.

## Before starting

- [ ] Seacocks open
- [x] Raw water strainer clear
- [ ] Fuel valve open

## Cruise numbers

| RPM | Fuel burn |
| - | - |
| 1850 | 6 gal/hr |
| 2100 | 8 gal/hr |

See [the fuel valve layout](hc-note:0f3b1c2e-8a4d-4f21-9c33-1d2e3f4a5b6c) if unsure which valve.
